'''Platinum's Lopunny''' (Japanese: '''プラチナのミミロップ''' ''Platinum's Mimilop'') is a {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} that {{adv|Platinum}} owns in [[Pokémon Adventures]] and her third overall. She is Platinum's first capture after starting her journey. As of ''[[PS440|The Final Dimensional Duel X]]'', she is at [[level]] 51, and her [[Characteristic]] is that she is "alert to sounds."

==History==
==={{MangaArc|Diamond & Pearl}}===
[[File:Platinum Lopunny vs Volkner Elekid.png|thumb|200px|left|Lopunny battling Volkner's Elekid]]
{{adv|Platinum}} caught Lopunny sometime prior to ''[[PS387|Striking Out Snover]]'', and was her first capture after starting her journey to [[Mount Coronet]]. She was first seen in ''[[PS388|To and Fro with Froslass]]'', participating in Platinum's [[Gym]] battle against [[Candice]] and her {{p|Abomasnow}}. Lopunny initially struggled due to Platinum's hesitancy since they had never battled before, but she soon shook it off and used Lopunny's agility and dance-like movements to defeat Abomasnow. Lopunny then went up against {{TP|Candice|Froslass}} and was immediately pinned down to prevent her from using the same strategy and was defeated. Before being defeated though, Platinum had Lopunny use {{m|Healing Wish}} in order to bring {{TP|Platinum|Rapidash}} back to full health, allowing Platinum to win the battle.

In ''[[PS405|Shorting Out Electivire]]'', Lopunny was Platinum's first choice in her battle against [[Volkner]] and called out against {{p|Elekid}}. Lopunny fired a barrage of {{m|Focus Blast}}s but ended up missing and getting hit by {{m|Focus Punch}}. Although Volkner thought the battle was over, Lopunny used her speed to sneak up behind Elekid and use {{m|Dizzy Punch}}, giving Platinum the first win.

==={{MangaArc|Platinum}}===
[[File:Platinum Lopunny Cute Charm effect.png|thumb|200px|left|Cute Charm activated]]
[[File:Platinum Lopunny vs Darach Houndoom.png|thumb|200px|Lopunny battling Darach's Houndoom]]
In ''[[PS420|Getting the Drop on Gallade II]]'', Lopunny participated in Platinum's [[Battle Castle]] challenge. Lopunny is picked as her last resort against [[Darach]] due to {{TP|Platinum|Empoleon}} and Rapidash being close to defeat. She first went up against his {{p|Houndoom}} and almost took it out with one hit, but Houndoom endured thanks to its [[Focus Sash]]. Houndoom then countered with {{m|Fire Fang}}, but Platinum switched into Empoleon before the attack could hit. Lopunny was later sent out to battle against Darach's {{p|Gallade}}. Due to the type disadvantage and the damage taken from the battle before, Lopunny was easily outmaneuvered and took a direct hit from {{m|Night Slash}}. Barely standing, Lopunny managed to crawl over to Gallade and land a weak Dizzy Punch before fainting. Darach laughed at her weakness, but soon found out that Gallade was inflicted with Lopunny's {{a|Cute Charm}} [[Ability]] and confused by Dizzy Punch. This allowed Empoleon to easily defeat him, giving Platinum the win.

In ''[[PS424|Exit Empoleon]]'', Lopunny fought in Platinum's [[Battle Arcade]] challenge. During the battle against [[Dahlia]], Platinum and Dahlia had to switch Pokémon due to the roulette, meaning Lopunny and Platinum's other Pokémon were forced to fight against their Trainer. Although both sides were reluctant at first, both Platinum and her Pokémon manage to fight at their full strength, which eventually ended with Platinum as the victor.

When Platinum went to challenge the {{gdis|Battle Factory|IV}} in ''[[PS426|Softening Up Kakuna]]'', she sent Lopunny and her other Pokémon to search for {{adv|Looker}} on [[Stark Mountain]], who had gone missing. They soon return, heavily injured and exhausted with a similarly injured Looker and [[Buck]].

In ''[[PS439|The Final Dimensional Duel IX]]'', Lopunny appeared once more during the battle against [[Charon]] inside the [[Distortion World]]. During the battle it was revealed that Platinum's whole [[party]] had caught [[Pokérus]] through her three new Pokémon, powering them up.

==Personality and characteristics==
[[File:Platinum and Lopunny.png|thumb|125px|Lopunny and Platinum]]
Lopunny is a powerful and agile battler, being able to dance around her opponents with ease. Despite being powerful, Platinum often uses her to help the rest of her team fight, by either inflicting status conditions to opponents or {{m|Healing Wish|healing}} her teammates. Lopunny has a strong connection with her {{pkmn|Trainer}} and was the most reluctant of her Pokémon to fight her during the [[Battle Arcade]] match.
